profile.description: Renaissance Services SAOG, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an accommodation, services solutions, and integrated facilities management company in Oman and rest of Middle East. The company offers turnkey and other contract services, including accommodation solutions, facilities management and establishment, contract catering, operations and maintenance, training, cleaning, and waste management services. It is also involved in the ownership, building, and operation of permanent accommodation for contractors; investment in companies and properties, as well as general trading and related activities; and integrated food service offering and laundry services. The company serves healthcare, energy, defense, education, utilities, and other sectors. Renaissance Services SAOG was founded in 1996 and is based in Muttrah, Oman.
